tldr: Global markets closed lower as rising oil prices and wholesale inflation data increased concerns about inflation and the likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike.
Scientists reported that August was the Earth's hottest month on record, primarily due to human-caused climate change.
Apple unveiled new products, including the foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, while Meta launched its new Muse AI assistant.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, influenced by rising oil prices and wholesale inflation data that fueled concerns about inflation. This also contributed to an increased likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, creating a 'danger zone' for stocks.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased as inflation pressures intensified, driven by oil prices reaching their highest levels since May and rising wholesale inflation data. This also heightened expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike.

vix.why: The VIX rose, reflecting increased investor anxiety stemming from concerns over heating inflation pressures and the heightened probability of an upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate hike.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 44% of the way up its 1-month band.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, reported in a weekly survey released on 2026-09-03, saw an increase. This movement aligns with the recent surge in 10-year Treasury yields, which were impacted by rising oil prices and wholesale inflation data.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_week.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

tech.summary: Apple announced its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, along with the iPhone 18 Pro and new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 models.
Meta launched its new Muse AI assistant, which aims to help users with tasks such as online shopping, emails, and trip planning.
Amazon is piloting new advertising services within ChatGPT, integrating ads into the AI chatbot's platform.

world.summary: NATO's chief stated that Russia's actions have bolstered Europe's argument for increased defense spending, as Europeans increasingly recognize the need for greater responsibility in their own security.

Houthi forces captured the strategic Yemeni town of Mocha, a development analysts say delivers a significant blow to the Yemeni government, expands Houthi control over Bab al-Mandeb, and threatens global trade routes.
Counter-terrorism police in London arrested a man and a woman on suspicion of assisting Iran's foreign intelligence service, following searches at addresses in north and north-west London.
A new documentary film, produced by the Guardian, features testimony from 24 Israeli military insiders revealing secret systems allegedly used in the mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza.

us.summary: The US Supreme Court again rejected an effort to redraw Missouri's congressional maps, setting the stage for the state to use its previous electoral maps for the upcoming midterms.

Investigators released new details from the flight data recorder of the Amazon cargo plane that careened off a Miami runway, indicating a pilot repeatedly warned his counterpart they were going too fast.
A Florida man was scheduled for execution after being convicted of kidnapping and strangling Richard Allen Montgomery in 1996, one of a series of suspected killings known as the Hog Trail Murders.

science.summary: Scientists reported that August was the Earth's hottest month on record, with the heat surge attributed largely to human-caused climate change.
A U.S. pediatrician described her experience treating Ebola's youngest victims in the Democratic Republic of Congo, highlighting the unprecedented challenges faced in the outbreak.
